title: Incline Dumbbell Press
summary: A dumbbell press on a 30–45° bench for the upper chest, with a long stretch at the bottom.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for chest (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly chest total.
Library rating 0.6 for front delts (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly front delts total.
Library rating 0.4 for triceps (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly triceps total.

setup.text: Set the bench at 30–45° and kick the dumbbells up to your shoulders as you lie back.
Pull your shoulder blades back and keep your chest up.
Press up until your arms are straight above your upper chest.
Lower slowly until your elbows are a little below the bench.

form_cues.cue: Lower to the sides of your upper chest
Press up without clanking the bells
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows.

mistakes.text: Flaring elbows straight out to the sides at the bottom.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.
